motion_rule: he shoulders down the locker alley all clip while cards, snow and workers burst on his coat at the lens every beat; the camera tracks alongside, locker rows sweeping past, his face to the lens, his head half the frame; new shot size each beat, one action per beat; the tall frame filled, no bars
character: a shaggy musk ox, heavy fringed coat, broad horns, muzzle clear of his hooves
second_characters: three workers in orange vests and hard hats, each leaning out of an open locker door a shoulder from the lens, slinging shovels of snow sideways across the frame onto him
props: ONE plastic card frozen into his chest fur from the first beat; A SWARM of loyalty cards in every colour heaped over a drift on his back
prop_continuity: the card in his chest fur shows from 0.00 to 10.00; the drift grows every beat and goes over his head at 8.10
environment: a parcel alley at noon, locker walls to the roof both sides a hoof away, doors banging open along them, crates and banked snow on their tops, no far wall
light_events: blazing noon, sun off the snow throwing white light up onto his muzzle, a white flash on each shovel

audio.language: Russian, lines verbatim; latin hints never spoken
audio.delivery: a heavy weary bass, biting each word, 4 syllables/sec
audio.pronunciation: pod-PI-sok, u men-YA, TSE-ly, sug-ROB, ne ZNA-yu, chto da-YUT, no pla-CHU
audio.pacing: 0.60-3.45, 4.15-5.80 and 6.45-7.35 each one breath; after 7.35 not a word, sfx keep going
audio.lip_sync: his mouth opens wide and shapes every syllable
audio.sfx: hooves on snow, doors banging, shovels scraping, cards rustling

timeline.a: he shoulders a locker door out of his way and it swings across the frame
he swings his head to the lens and the card in his chest fur catches the sun
he hauls his shoulders past a crate and cards rake off it across the frame
he throws his horns up and a load of cards slides forward onto his brow
the drift on his back rises over his shoulders as he keeps walking
a worker kicks his locker door open a shoulder from the lens and slings a shovel of snow sideways onto his flank
he shakes the snow off his muzzle without breaking stride, cards spinning off
a second door bangs open and another shovelful rakes across his chest
he drives his shoulder through the drift and cards burst at the lens
he pulls one card out of his fur with his teeth and it springs straight back in
all three workers lean out at once and sling their shovels together, snow crossing the frame from both walls
the drift and the cards close over his horns and he vanishes under the heap, still moving forward
his horns and muzzle burst out of the heap at the lens, cards flying off, jaw working
he walks on with the heap riding his back while the workers pull their doors shut behind him

must_appear: the card in his chest fur from first beat to last; workers leaning out of the locker doors slinging snow sideways onto him; the heap of coloured cards growing on his back every beat; at 8.10 it closes over his head and at 8.85 his horns burst back out at the lens
negative_prompt: subtitles, watermark, letterbox, night, dark scene, cyrillic letters, words, a parked camera, a closed mouth while speaking, slow motion, a camera pulling back, snow falling straight down, a wide empty snowfield, a far horizon, a foreign accent, a word not in the lines
